Florida Man Allegedly Drives Off in a $150,000 G-Wagon After Telling the Valet It Was His

No ticket, no problem: police say a downtown Tampa valet stand handed over the keys, and GPS did the rest.

A woman left her 2021 Mercedes G63 with the valet at the Marriott Waterside in downtown Tampa on Friday, Nov. 20, and came back to learn someone had picked it up hours earlier. Tampa police say a 27-year-old man acted like the SUV was his, told attendants he was ready to leave and drove off. Officers tracked the G-Wagon by GPS and arrested him about 30 minutes after the call; he faces grand theft and three other charges.
